summary: Iteration 4 review of ReviewBoost's new features (bulk actions + pagination, logo/shop-photo upload via object storage, first-login 3-step walkthrough) plus regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 25 to 39 pytest cases (new classes TestBusinessImages, TestBulkDelete, TestOnboarding) - 39/39 passed. New coverage: logo PNG + photo JPEG upload (200, clean_business has no _id/logo_path), persistence via GET /api/settings, public image GET returns image/png & image/jpeg without auth, non-image (.txt) -> 422 with owner-friendly message, unknown kind -> 404, unauth -> 401, DELETE image clears url and public image then 404, bulk-delete removes exactly the selected ids (total drops by 2, untouched row still present), empty ids -> 422, unknown ids -> deleted:0, cross-user isolation (another account cannot delete owner's reviews), onboarding_done false for a brand-new account -> POST /api/onboarding/complete -> true and still true after a fresh login, unauth -> 401. Frontend (Playwright on the preview URL): bulk selection (3 selected bar, Copy all copies 3 blocks to clipboard + toast, Clear deselects, header checkbox selects exactly the 10 rows of the current page and deselects them, selection is kept across page change while the header checkbox correctly reads unchecked on page 2), Delete all with window.confirm -> '2 reviews deleted', total 18->16, bulk bar auto-cleared; pagination (Page 1 of 2, prev disabled on page 1, Sr. No. continues at 11 on page 2, next disabled on last page, rows-per-page 25 -> Page 1 of 1 with 18 rows, back to 10 resets to page 1); Settings uploads (logo PNG 200x200 and shop photo 600x300 previews render with naturalWidth>0, 'Logo updated'/'Shop photo updated' toasts, .txt upload -> 'Please upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP image' toast and existing preview untouched, Remove -> placeholder + 'Logo removed' and persists after reload, re-upload works, images survive a page reload); public /r/PCiXONhzO_7mFA on 390x844 shows the shop-photo banner, logo, 'Sharma Dental' + 'Dental Clinic - Pune', 6 tappable cards, tap -> clipboard matches the draft text -> redirect to the Google Maps review URL; walkthrough on two brand-new registrations (3 dots with 1 active, Step 1/2/3 titles, Next advances, 'Start setup' closes and navigates to /settings, no modal after reload or after logout+re-login; Skip dismisses it permanently, still gone after reload). Regression all pass: login, ADD NEW generation (prefill, count 10, 15->25, '10 reviews are ready'), single edit + reload persistence, single delete with confirm, single regenerate (text changed), category add/delete with confirm dialog, Google link validation (invalid -> error toast, valid -> Saved), change password wrong-current -> error toast, logout, desktop sidebar X now hidden (previous bug fixed), /reviews mobile 390 no horizontal overflow (previous bug fixed), used-count stat now consistent (computed from rows).

minor.issue: Validation is extension-only (no magic-byte/Pillow check). A non-image renamed to .png is accepted with 200 and then renders as a broken image on Settings and on the public customer page (reproduced: uploaded a 209-byte fake .jpg -> preview naturalWidth=0, alt text shown).

The public payload URLs have no ?v={version} cache-buster while /api/public/{slug}/image/{kind} returns Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600. After an owner replaces the logo/photo, customers can keep seeing the old image for up to an hour (the authenticated clean_business() URL does include ?v=).
Only $unset of {kind}_path in Mongo; the object is never deleted from object storage and {kind}_content_type is left behind - orphaned objects accumulate on every replace/remove.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 the public URL text causes page-level horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth 464 vs clientWidth 390). Culprit measured: <strong data-testid="settings-public-url"> width 423px, right edge 464px. The same fix applied to .link-banner a on /reviews (overflow-wrap:anywhere / word-break:break-all + max-width:100%) was not applied here.
has no onError fallback: if the stored object is unreadable/corrupt the user just sees the broken-image alt text with no message or retry.

issues: Dot indicators have no data-testid (only .dots span) - testing had to fall back to a CSS class
Modal has no scrim click / Esc handling; only Skip or Next/Start setup can dismiss it

Selection is retained across pages but there is no hint that the N selected includes rows from other pages, so 'Delete all' can remove rows the owner can no longer see - consider listing the count per page or clearing selection on page change

action_items: Add overflow-wrap:anywhere / word-break:break-all (and max-width:100%) to [data-testid="settings-public-url"] so /settings has no horizontal overflow at 390px
Validate uploaded image bytes (magic bytes or PIL open) not just the file extension, so a renamed non-image cannot be stored and shown as a broken image
Include the ?v={version} cache-buster in the public payload logo_url/photo_url (or lower Cache-Control) so replaced images are visible to customers immediately
Delete the previous object from storage on replace/remove and also $unset {kind}_content_type
critical_code_review_comments: regenerate_review still builds GenerateIn(count=10) and calls generate_batch(cfg, 1) - the count field is now unused in the prompt path so it is harmless, but the dead count=10 override is misleading; pass count=1.
GET /api/public/{slug} still falls back to `visible = [...] or rows`, so a repeat customer whose session cookie hides everything is served an already-used review.

Reviews.js keeps selected ids across pagination and page-size changes; deleteSelected then deletes rows that are not visible. Either scope the selection to the current page or surface it clearly in the bulk bar.
Settings.js and PublicReview.js both build image URLs as `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${url}`; a single helper would avoid drift, and neither handles the 404/unreadable case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional flows; 1 medium CSS overflow + 1 low robustness issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth page test ids are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button / auth-mode-toggle (NOT login-*). window.confirm dialogs must be accepted with page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept())) - a plain d.accept() in a lambda is a never-awaited coroutine and the click times out. Register with a real-looking domain: *.test / *.invalid are rejected by EmailStr (422). Public slug is PCiXONhzO_7mFA. Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (39 cases, pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope); image tests upload and then remove the owner's logo/photo, so run UI upload tests after pytest.
rca_of_the_issue: /settings mobile overflow: the QR card renders the public URL inside a plain <strong data-testid="settings-public-url"> with no word-break, so the 423px unbreakable URL exceeds the 390px viewport and pushes documentElement.scrollWidth to 464. Broken-image case: upload_business_image only checks the filename extension against MIME_TYPES, so arbitrary bytes named *.png are stored and later served with media_type image/png, which the browser cannot decode (naturalWidth 0) and no onError fallback exists.
